title: Work item type eval fragment
description: types/<type>/eval/fragment.yaml: the typed prose scripts/generate_eval_config.py splices into eval/config/skeleton.yaml to produce the type's committed eval config (design work-item-types-unified.md section 4.5). Every key is a slot the skeleton references as ${fragment.<dotted>}; identity, dirs, score fields and thresholds are read from type.yaml, never restated here. A `line` is one line of prose; a `block` is a multi-line text inserted at the slot's indentation (an empty block removes the slot line).

entity_long.description: The entity name as the quality judge introduces it, e.g. "RFE (Request for Enhancement)".

timeout_note.description: Trailing comment on execution.timeout explaining the calibration (the value itself is eval.timeout in type.yaml).

prompt.description: What input.yaml's `prompt` holds for this type.

clarifying_context.description: The full `- clarifying_context (string): ...` list item of the dataset schema, wrapped as it should appear.

questions_context.description: Continuation of the AskUserQuestion interception matcher: which clarifying questions the create skill asks.

questions_answer.description: How the interceptor should answer them from input.yaml (the shared default line follows).

task_fields.description: Task frontmatter fields as prose (the harness shows it to the judges).

task_sections.description: The `Body sections: ...` line(s) of the task schema.

review_files.description: Per-dimension review companions ({ID}-feasibility.md, ...); {ID}-review.md and {ID}-split-status.yaml are shared.

review_body.description: The `Body of review: ...` line(s) of the review schema.

not_relevant_pattern.description: Case-insensitive regex; a feasibility review matching it counts as grounded even when its writer never read .context/architecture-context. null: no carve-out, every review must be grounded.

not_relevant_note.description: Sentence(s) appended to the architecture_context_used judge description explaining the carve-out; empty when not_relevant_pattern is null.

criteria.description: The quality judge's bullet list of rubric criteria (one bullet per score field, in rubric order).

extra_checks.description: Optional paragraph of extra verdicts the quality judge cross-checks (feasibility, alignment, ...); empty for none.

assessments.description: The revision_quality judge's **Revision quality** / **Content fidelity** / ... paragraphs, blank-line separated.

threshold_notes.description: Map judge name -> calibration note rendered as a comment above that judge's threshold entry. Keys must be judges of eval.thresholds in type.yaml.
